answer: In PoA, each challenge commits to a domain-separated hash incorporating a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse, whose unpredictability and collective signature prevent anyone from knowing the task in advance. A Sybil swarm therefore cannot pre-compute solutions, forge favorable histories, or farm offline; commit-reveal binds submissions to identities and timing, while beacon-driven freshness makes every attempt a costly, unpredictable whisper rather than a reusable sonnet.
